verdict.rationale: Bruno's docs say you can write documentation alongside collections and publish it as shareable HTML. A rich-text Docs editor and AI-assisted doc writing in the Docs tab support the generation side. missing for 10: detailed docs on the publish/HTML export workflow (hosting, theming, CLI automation), evidence of generating docs from OpenAPI specs rather than collections, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate and publish API documentation from my collections or specs

citations.quote: Write docs with your collections; publish as shareable HTML.
Open the Docs tab, click the AI icon, and describe the endpoint or workflow. Bruno writes the documentation for you to review and accept.
